I also have the same question about removing background. I started with SpatialShrunkenCentroids() or SpatialKMeans() functions with 2 clusters, so I can extract pixels and features related to either matrix or matrix+sample:

messages.subject: intensities subtracting
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,
In searching of the best way to remove matrix influence i decided to subtract mean matrix intensity from every pixel. At first I made a subset with just matrix (found it visually):

file_subset <- subsetPixels(file, x %in% 40:50, y %in% 10:25)

than found mean spectra:

subset_mean_spectra <- featureApply(file_subset, mean)

And now I want to create a new file (which can be clustered with wonderful Cardinal function). I guess it should work with pixelApply() function like:

new_file <- pixelApply(file, function(x))

And the problem is in function(x), how can I create such function that will subtract subset_mean_spectra from other pixel's spectra? Is it possible?

Thank you in advance,
Marina

messages.body_plain:

How do I convert them all to the same ImagingExperiment? When I tried to combine them, I got an error "number of rows of matrices must match." How do I set all the matrix rows the same?

Krista
